title: fix: highscore in-game window always shows 1 page instead of paginating
body:
After PR #3222, the highscore window stopped paginating — it always showed `1 / 1` regardless of total player count, effectively capping visible results to a single page of 20 rows.

## Root cause

`processHighscoreResults` derived total page count from the SQL column `entries`, which is aliased from `rn` — the **per-row sequential number** in the result set, not the total matching count. For page 1 with 20 entries/page, the first result row has `rn = 1`, so:

```
pages = (1 + 19) / 20 = 1   // always equals current page number
```

## Fix

The inner subquery already tracks total matching rows via the `@row` MySQL session variable (`(@row := @row + 1) AS rn`). After that subquery fully executes, `@row` holds the true total — the outer page-filtering `WHERE` doesn't touch it.

- **`generateHighscoreQuery`** — add `@row AS \`total\`` to the outer `SELECT` to expose the total count.
- **`processHighscoreResults`** — read `"total"` instead of `"entries"` for the pages calculation.

```sql
-- Before
SELECT `id`, ..., `rn` AS `entries`, ...

-- After
SELECT `id`, ..., `rn` AS `entries`, @row AS `total`, ...
```

```cpp
// Before
auto pages = result->getNumber<uint32_t>("entries");

// After
auto pages = result->getNumber<uint32_t>("total");
```
